feature_definition: concatenate own/neighbor64 from each of both frozen parent encoders (256 total), own/neighbor historical logs12, calendar35+phase3+lagged weather54, recent proxy4, log1p ensemble average rentals/returns2
sampling: PCG64(seed+epoch) uniform valid historical issue times with replacement, same draws per seed across configurations
gaussian_definition: 366->64SiLU->64SiLU->rank; L=tanh(raw)*.95/sqrt(rank), diag sd=sqrt(1-sum L^2); zero mean unit marginal covariance; masked Woodbury Gaussian NLL on independent randomized-PIT targets
flow_definition: condition366->64SiLU->64; latent scalar+flowtime[t,sin(pi*t),cos(pi*t),t²] stem5->64;4 residual own/normalized masked historical graph/global pooled linear64 and LayerNorm blocks; zero initialized scalar output; masked whole-cohort CFM
flow_coupling: source conditional Gaussian from frozen selected rank; per-issue independent Gaussian/observed historical target coupling; per-node independent Uniform for randomized signed Skellam-mixture PIT; epsilon1e-5; masks exclude unsupported nodes from targets/message passing
marginal_definition: H13 predeclared recent GCN Poisson seeds11/29 equal mixture, never selected by API rank; sample signed returns-rentals once per node/particle for all dependence methods

generation.seed_mixture: one seed model per entire global scenario; common Gaussian noise for Gaussian/FM, distinct fixed tie/shuffle streams
generation.rank_reorder: lexsort(template,independent tie noise); enforce exact sorted signed marginal sets and same monotone stock mapping

layout.algorithm: historical symmetrized row-normalizedOD weights; choose highest weighted degree unassigned seed, then max total affinity to region; ties degree then lex stationID; size16, last6 kept; no API-driven regrouping
layout.pairs: 2048 uniformly sampled historical edges +2048 nonedges, deterministicPCG64seed20261104; equal half total weights
layout.scale: train-only max(1,sqrt(mean net² over source-supported node exposures))

checkpoint.gaussian: each seed every epoch0..16 lowest fixed February post-ECC regional completed-outflow CRPS; ties earliest; choose rank by2-seed ensemble same score, ties rank8
checkpoint.flow: each seed epochs0,2,4,8,12,16,20 lowest same post-ECC February metric, ties earliest; selected Gaussian fixed
checkpoint.selection_issues: 2 source-valid times per interior February day,52 fixed timestamps PCG6420261104; common fixed marginal and template streams
checkpoint.auxiliary_issues: 1 source-valid time per March day,29 fixed timestamps; report once after lock, no reselection

historical_gate.metric: U_g=mean_i max(-completed_net_i,0); ordinary regional ensemble CRPS after coupling
historical_gate.on_failure: withdrawn: historical gate failed; September primary unexecuted, never substitute count score for inventory score

api.inputs: previous/current only, finite nonnegative integer stock, delay0..120, past elapsed480..720; missing proxy mask, never future validity for generation
api.truth: future finite stock with delay0..120 and elapsed480..720; complete fixed region and max-min timestamp<=30sec at both endpoints for regional score; no changing group membership
api.primary: minimum relative reduction in pooled equal-region zero-fraction CRPS vs3controls; ordinary empiricalM²
secondary: individual stock CRPS/MAE/Brier exact marginal identity

execution_contract: publish frozen plan/code before learning/comparison; raw/API/keys/hosts/large weights remain private; model lock before external API; no API fitting/tuning/calibration; internal gate fail stops API; preserve all configurations/failures; clock uses collector launch plus remote monotonic elapsed with native remote time retained
